concentration.caliber: share of all middle-hop change events that fall into the ten (pair, direction) groups with the most events

attribution.description: Attribution of the middle-hop change: which direction groups carry it, how concentrated it is, what the new pools have in common, and which closed loops have no fallback pool at all.

directionGroups.caliber: distinct (pair, direction) groups whose middle-hop pool changed, over all (pair, direction) groups of the market observation

loopsWithoutBackup.caliber: closed loops whose middle hop has no backup candidate; a pool change on such a loop cannot fall back

newPools.caliber: the pools the middle hop moves to, and the features they share; a concentration on one feature class is the signature of a pool class that should not have been selected at all

removedLoops.caliber: the closed loops the new caliber drops, with the gate that drops each of them; a loop without a backup pool has nowhere to fall back to

universeCoverage.caliber: whether the middle pool of a dropped loop exists in the target universe at all; a pool that is admitted but absent from the core4 base table is a coverage question, not a selection-order question

candidateOptions: adopt the new order as the default
adjust the main order before the change is made

evidence.caliber: distinct (pair, direction) groups whose middle-hop pool changed, over all (pair, direction) groups of the market observation
evidence.name: midChangeRate

evidence.caliber: (new closed loops - old closed loops) / old closed loops
evidence.name: loopNetRate

evidence.caliber: the median drop of the effective profit over the affected closed loops
evidence.name: profitDrop
evidence.role: economic cost; must be measured once in a live wave

evidence.caliber: closed loops whose middle hop has no backup candidate; a pool change on such a loop cannot fall back
evidence.name: loopsWithoutBackup

evidence.caliber: share of all middle-hop change events that fall into the ten (pair, direction) groups with the most events
evidence.name: changeConcentration

caliberVerdict.note: The script collects the readings and the attribution and refuses to decide. The former thresholds are now readings: they describe where the change lands, they no longer gate anything. The verdict stays with a human.

midChangePoolCount.caliber: the distinct pools the middle hop moves to, over the usable base pools
midChangePoolCount.role: how far the pool universe itself moved

profitDrop.reason: the old profit is unmeasured on 154 of 168 closed loops and the new profit needs the arbiter to run against the new pool path, which a read-only wave may not imitate
